+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Plug-in equicontinuity.}
+On the canonically ordered collision stratum, write the one-cycle null scores
+as \(s_\eta\) and \(s_\delta\), and define
+\[
+ \psi_\eta=s_\delta-I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}s_\eta,
+ \qquad
+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}
+ \sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\psi_\eta(G_j).
+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|
+ =o_{P_{\eta,0}}(1).
+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere
+in the same root-\(N\) ball, converge uniformly to \(I_n(\eta)\) and
+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.

+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}

+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|

+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere

+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.

 \section{Proof of the limit-experiment theorem}
 
+The proof uses the following exact supplementary inputs.  Their proofs are
+\Cref*{lem:uniform-sampled-bin-tail-score-main,lem:uniform-stopped-renewal-score-main,lem:efficient-score-plugin-main}
+of the supplementary material.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Plug-in equicontinuity.}
+On the canonically ordered collision stratum, write the one-cycle null scores
+as \(s_\eta\) and \(s_\delta\), and define
+\[
+ \psi_\eta=s_\delta-I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}s_\eta,
+ \qquad
+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}
+ \sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\psi_\eta(G_j).
+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|
+ =o_{P_{\eta,0}}(1).
+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere
+in the same root-\(N\) ball, converge uniformly to \(I_n(\eta)\) and
+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.
+

+\begin{estimator}[Measurable sampled-tail recurrence estimator]
+\label{est:serial-collision-recurrence-main}
+Delete the two incomplete endpoint cycles and let
+\(G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\) be the complete zero-run gaps.  Form
+\[
+ \widehat S_k=K_N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\mathbf1_{\{G_j\ge k\}},
+ \qquad0\le k\le2n-1,
+\tag{3.17}
+\]
+with fixed values when \(K_N=0\).  Solve the empirical Hankel recurrence on
+its nonsingular gate, use a fixed fallback otherwise, and select measurably
+from a finite analytic contour atlas separating the unique two-root cluster
+from the \(n-2\) simple roots.  In the cluster, use its elementary symmetric
+coordinates and transform them analytically to \((c,\widetilde\delta)\);
+set \(\widehat\delta=(\widetilde\delta)^+\).  The resulting estimators are
+total and Borel measurable and satisfy, uniformly over the compact stratum and
+bounded local alternatives,
+\[
+ \widehat\eta_N-\eta_N=O_P(N^{-1/2}),\qquad
+ \widehat\delta_N-\delta_N=O_P(N^{-1/2}).
+\tag{3.18}
+\]
+The pair \(\widehat c_N\pm\sqrt{\widehat\delta_N}\), together with the
+canonically ordered simple-rate estimates, gives \textup{(3.13)}.
+\end{estimator}
+
+The finite vector of empirical tail coordinates is root-\(N\), and
+invertibility from \Cref{prop:serial-tail-coordinates-main} gives root-\(N\)
+recurrence coefficients.  Simple roots and the two-root cluster have
+compatible analytic charts, while \((c,\delta)\) are regular analytic cluster
+coordinates.  Projection onto \([0,\infty)\) is nonexpansive, and
+\(|\sqrt{x^+}-\sqrt y|\le\sqrt{|x-y|}\) for \(y\ge0\).  The finite-atlas
+contour construction and measurability proof are in
+\Cref*{sec:estimator-atlas-supp} of the supplementary material.

+For the collision test, write the null one-cycle score as
+\[
+ s_{\eta,0}(k)=
+ \begin{pmatrix}s_{\rm nuis}(k;\eta)\\s_\delta(k;\eta)\end{pmatrix}.
+\]
+Fix a compact null-coordinate neighbourhood \(\mathcal E_0\) whose interior
+contains the stratum projection and whose closure lies in the common score
+chart.  For \(\eta\in\mathcal E_0\), define the empirical calendar information
+\[
+ I_N(\eta)=\frac1N\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}
+ s_{\eta,0}(G_j)s_{\eta,0}(G_j)^\top,
+\tag{3.19}
+\]

+\((\eta,\delta)\), and define its empirical Schur complement by
+\[
+ J_N(\eta)=
+ \begin{cases}
+ I_{\delta\delta,N}-I_{\delta\eta,N}
+ I_{\eta\eta,N}^{-1}I_{\eta\delta,N},
+ &\eta\in\mathcal E_0,\ \lambda_{\min}(I_{\eta\eta,N})>0,\\
+ 0,&\text{otherwise}.
+ \end{cases}
+\tag{3.20}
+\]
+Let \(\widehat\eta_N\) be the recurrence fit and
+\(\mathcal G_N=\{\widehat\eta_N\in\mathcal E_0,
+J_N(\widehat\eta_N)>0\}\).  On \(\mathcal G_N\), put
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ Z_N&=\frac{N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}
+ \left[s_\delta(G_j;\widehat\eta_N)
+ -I_{\delta\eta,N}(\widehat\eta_N)

+ \phi_N&=\mathbf1_{\{Z_N>z_{1-\alpha}\}}.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{3.21}
+\]
+The score-chart, singular-block, and nonpositive-Schur-complement gates make
+the construction total: off \(\mathcal G_N\), set \(\phi_N=0\), the default
+nonrejection.  These gates are uniformly asymptotically inactive.

+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete

+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).

+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(

+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)

+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[

+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.

+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.

# Verification Before Completion

## Overview

Claiming work is complete without verification is dishonesty, not efficiency.

**Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.

**Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**

## The Iron Law

```
NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
```

If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.

## The Gate Function

```
BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:

1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
   - If NO: State actual status with evidence
   - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim

Skip any step = lying, not verifying
```

## Common Failures

| Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
|-------|----------|----------------|
| Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
| Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
| Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
| Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
| Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
| Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
| Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |

## Red Flags - STOP

- Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
- Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
- About to commit/push/PR without verification
- Trusting agent success reports
- Relying on partial verification
- Thinking "just this once"
- Tired and wanting work over
- **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**

## Rationalization Prevention

| Excuse | Reality |
|--------|---------|
| "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
| "I'm confident" | Confidence â‰  evidence |
| "Just this once" | No exceptions |
| "Linter passed" | Linter â‰  compiler |
| "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
| "I'm tired" | Exhaustion â‰  excuse |
| "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
| "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |

## Key Patterns

**Tests:**
```
âœ… [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
âŒ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
```

**Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
```
âœ… Write â†’ Run (pass) â†’ Revert fix â†’ Run (MUST FAIL) â†’ Restore â†’ Run (pass)
âŒ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
```

**Build:**
```
âœ… [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"
âŒ "Linter passed" (linter doesn't check compilation)
```

**Requirements:**
```
âœ… Re-read plan â†’ Create checklist â†’ Verify each â†’ Report gaps or completion
âŒ "Tests pass, phase complete"
```

**Agent delegation:**
```
âœ… Agent reports success â†’ Check VCS diff â†’ Verify changes â†’ Report actual state
âŒ Trust agent report
```

## Why This Matters

From 24 failure memories:
- your human partner said "I don't believe you" - trust broken
- Undefined functions shipped - would crash
- Missing requirements shipped - incomplete features
- Time wasted on false completion â†’ redirect â†’ rework
- Violates: "Honesty is a core value. If you lie, you'll be replaced."

## When To Apply

**ALWAYS before:**
- ANY variation of success/completion claims
- ANY expression of satisfaction
- ANY positive statement about work state
- Committing, PR creation, task completion
- Moving to next task
- Delegating to agents

**Rule applies to:**
- Exact phrases
- Paraphrases and synonyms
- Implications of success
- ANY communication suggesting completion/correctness

## The Bottom Line

**No shortcuts for verification.**

Run the command. Read the output. THEN claim the result.

This is non-negotiable.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Plug-in equicontinuity.}

+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}
+ \sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\psi_\eta(G_j).
+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|
+ =o_{P_{\eta,0}}(1).
+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere
+in the same root-\(N\) ball, converge uniformly to \(I_n(\eta)\) and
+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.

+\begin{estimator}[Measurable sampled-tail recurrence estimator]

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[

+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped

+triangular arrays.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Plug-in equicontinuity.}

+as \(s_\eta\) and \(s_\delta\), and define
+\[

+ \qquad
+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}
+ \sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\psi_\eta(G_j).
+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|
+ =o_{P_{\eta,0}}(1).
+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere
+in the same root-\(N\) ball, converge uniformly to \(I_n(\eta)\) and
+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.

\begin{theorem}[Stationary isolated-double-pole limit experiment]
\label{thm:stationary-serial-double-pole-main}
Fix \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), known \(\Delta\tau>0\), and the serial positive
killed-reset realization \textup{(1.2)}--\textup{(1.3)}, and suppose
\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\ne\varnothing\).  Let
\(P_{\eta,\delta}^{(N)}\) be the stationary length-\(N\) binary renewal
record in this fixed serial order, at one isolated real double pole with all
other rates simple and separated as in \textup{(3.1)}.

\smallskip\noindent\textup{(A) Uniform LAN and the limit experiment.}
For bounded \(u\in\RR^{n-1}\) and \(v\in[0,\infty)\), uniformly over the
collision stratum,
\[
 \log\frac{dP_{\eta_0+u/\sqrt N,v/\sqrt N}^{(N)}}
 {dP_{\eta_0,0}^{(N)}}
 =\begin{pmatrix}u\\v\end{pmatrix}^{\!\top}\Delta_{N,\eta_0}
 -\frac12\begin{pmatrix}u\\v\end{pmatrix}^{\!\top}
 I_n(\eta_0)\begin{pmatrix}u\\v\end{pmatrix}
 +o_{P_{\eta_0,0}}(1),
\tag{3.10}
\]
where
\(\Delta_{N,\eta_0}\Rightarrow\mathcal N_n\{0,I_n(\eta_0)\}\)
uniformly in bounded-Lipschitz distance.  The local experiments converge to
the Gaussian shift on \(\RR^{n-1}\times[0,\infty)\), and the information is
uniformly nondegenerate by \textup{(3.5)}.

\smallskip\noindent\textup{(B) Efficient collision test.}
Partition \(I_n\) according to \((\eta,\delta)\) and set
\[
 J_n(\eta)=I_{\delta\delta}
 -I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}I_{\eta\delta}>0.
\tag{3.11}
\]
The residualized-score test \(\phi_N\) in \textup{(3.21)} has uniform
asymptotic level \(\alpha\).  At
\((\eta_N,\delta_N)=(\eta_0+u/\sqrt N,v/\sqrt N)\), its limiting power is
\[
 1-\Phi_{\rm N}\{z_{1-\alpha}-v\sqrt{J_n(\eta_0)}\}.
\tag{3.12}
\]
This is the Gaussian half-space power envelope among tests with uniform local
asymptotic level \(\alpha\).

\smallskip\noindent\textup{(C) Attainable and lower recovery rates.}
The measurable procedure in \Cref{est:serial-collision-recurrence-main}
gives root-\(N\) estimates of \(\eta\) and \(\delta\) and an induced rate
multiset \(\widehat{\mathcal R}_{n,N}\) satisfying
\[
 d_{\rm m}\!\left(\widehat{\mathcal R}_{n,N},
 \{\!\{c_N+\sqrt{\delta_N},c_N-\sqrt{\delta_N},
 \theta_{3,N},\ldots,\theta_{n,N}\}\!\}\right)=O_P(N^{-1/4})
\tag{3.13}
\]
uniformly over the compact stratum and bounded \((u,v)\).  The centre and
canonically ordered separated rates remain root-\(N\).  At every fixed base,
\Cref{lem:two-point-threshold-rate-main} gives a strictly positive lower
limit for threshold risk on two alternatives separated by
\(\sqrt{v_0}N^{-1/4}\).  Hence \(N^{-1/4}\) is uniformly attainable on the
stated bounded local families and pointwise locally minimax-optimal in rate.
\end{theorem}

 \section{Proof of the limit-experiment theorem}
 
+The proof uses the following exact supplementary inputs.  Their proofs are

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Plug-in equicontinuity.}
+On the canonically ordered collision stratum, write the one-cycle null scores
+as \(s_\eta\) and \(s_\delta\), and define
+\[
+ \psi_\eta=s_\delta-I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}s_\eta,
+ \qquad
+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}
+ \sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\psi_\eta(G_j).
+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|
+ =o_{P_{\eta,0}}(1).
+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere
+in the same root-\(N\) ball, converge uniformly to \(I_n(\eta)\) and
+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.

+\subsection{Recurrence estimator and residualized statistic}
+
+\begin{estimator}[Measurable sampled-tail recurrence estimator]
+\label{est:serial-collision-recurrence-main}
+Delete the two incomplete endpoint cycles and let
+\(G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\) be the complete zero-run gaps.  Form
+\[
+ \widehat S_k=K_N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\mathbf1_{\{G_j\ge k\}},
+ \qquad0\le k\le2n-1,
+\tag{3.17}
+\]
+with fixed values when \(K_N=0\).  Solve the empirical Hankel recurrence on
+its nonsingular gate, use a fixed fallback otherwise, and select measurably
+from a finite analytic contour atlas separating the unique two-root cluster
+from the \(n-2\) simple roots.  In the cluster, use its elementary symmetric
+coordinates and transform them analytically to \((c,\widetilde\delta)\);
+set \(\widehat\delta=(\widetilde\delta)^+\).  The resulting estimators are
+total and Borel measurable and satisfy, uniformly over the compact stratum and
+bounded local alternatives,
+\[
+ \widehat\eta_N-\eta_N=O_P(N^{-1/2}),\qquad
+ \widehat\delta_N-\delta_N=O_P(N^{-1/2}).
+\tag{3.18}
+\]
+The pair \(\widehat c_N\pm\sqrt{\widehat\delta_N}\), together with the
+canonically ordered simple-rate estimates, gives \textup{(3.13)}.
+\end{estimator}
+
+The finite vector of empirical tail coordinates is root-\(N\), and
+invertibility from \Cref{prop:serial-tail-coordinates-main} gives root-\(N\)
+recurrence coefficients.  Simple roots and the two-root cluster have
+compatible analytic charts, while \((c,\delta)\) are regular analytic cluster
+coordinates.  Projection onto \([0,\infty)\) is nonexpansive, and
+\(|\sqrt{x^+}-\sqrt y|\le\sqrt{|x-y|}\) for \(y\ge0\).  The finite-atlas
+contour construction and measurability proof are in
+\Cref*{sec:estimator-atlas-supp} of the supplementary material.
+
+For the collision test, write the null one-cycle score as
+\[
+ s_{\eta,0}(k)=
+ \begin{pmatrix}s_{\rm nuis}(k;\eta)\\s_\delta(k;\eta)\end{pmatrix}.
+\]
+Fix a compact null-coordinate neighbourhood \(\mathcal E_0\) whose interior
+contains the stratum projection and whose closure lies in the common score
+chart.  For \(\eta\in\mathcal E_0\), define the empirical calendar information
+\[
+ I_N(\eta)=\frac1N\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}
+ s_{\eta,0}(G_j)s_{\eta,0}(G_j)^\top,
+\tag{3.19}
+\]
+and set \(I_N(\eta)=0\) outside \(\mathcal E_0\).  Partition it according to
+\((\eta,\delta)\), and define its empirical Schur complement by
+\[
+ J_N(\eta)=
+ \begin{cases}
+ I_{\delta\delta,N}-I_{\delta\eta,N}
+ I_{\eta\eta,N}^{-1}I_{\eta\delta,N},
+ &\eta\in\mathcal E_0,\ \lambda_{\min}(I_{\eta\eta,N})>0,\\
+ 0,&\text{otherwise}.
+ \end{cases}
+\tag{3.20}
+\]
+Let \(\widehat\eta_N\) be the recurrence fit and
+\(\mathcal G_N=\{\widehat\eta_N\in\mathcal E_0,
+J_N(\widehat\eta_N)>0\}\).  On \(\mathcal G_N\), put
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ Z_N&=\frac{N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}
+ \left[s_\delta(G_j;\widehat\eta_N)
+ -I_{\delta\eta,N}(\widehat\eta_N)
+ I_{\eta\eta,N}(\widehat\eta_N)^{-1}
+ s_{\rm nuis}(G_j;\widehat\eta_N)\right]}
+ {\sqrt{J_N(\widehat\eta_N)}},\\
+ \phi_N&=\mathbf1_{\{Z_N>z_{1-\alpha}\}}.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{3.21}
+\]
+The score-chart, singular-block, and nonpositive-Schur-complement gates make
+the construction total: off \(\mathcal G_N\), set \(\phi_N=0\), the default
+nonrejection.  These gates are uniformly asymptotically inactive.

 \section{Proof of the limit-experiment theorem}
 
+The proof uses the following exact supplementary inputs.  Their proofs are
+\Cref*{lem:uniform-sampled-bin-tail-score-main,lem:uniform-stopped-renewal-score-main,lem:efficient-score-plugin-main}
+of the supplementary material.
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Plug-in equicontinuity.}
+On the canonically ordered collision stratum, write the one-cycle null scores
+as \(s_\eta\) and \(s_\delta\), and define
+\[
+ \psi_\eta=s_\delta-I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}s_\eta,
+ \qquad
+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}
+ \sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\psi_\eta(G_j).
+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|
+ =o_{P_{\eta,0}}(1).
+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere
+in the same root-\(N\) ball, converge uniformly to \(I_n(\eta)\) and
+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.
+

 \section{Proof of the limit-experiment theorem}
 
+The proof uses the following exact supplementary inputs.  Their proofs are
+\Cref*{lem:uniform-sampled-bin-tail-score-main,lem:uniform-stopped-renewal-score-main,lem:efficient-score-plugin-main}
+of the supplementary material.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Plug-in equicontinuity.}
+On the canonically ordered collision stratum, write the one-cycle null scores
+as \(s_\eta\) and \(s_\delta\), and define
+\[
+ \psi_\eta=s_\delta-I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}s_\eta,
+ \qquad
+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}
+ \sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\psi_\eta(G_j).
+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|
+ =o_{P_{\eta,0}}(1).
+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere
+in the same root-\(N\) ball, converge uniformly to \(I_n(\eta)\) and
+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.
+

+\subsection{Recurrence estimator and residualized statistic}
+
+\begin{estimator}[Measurable sampled-tail recurrence estimator]
+\label{est:serial-collision-recurrence-main}
+Delete the two incomplete endpoint cycles and let
+\(G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\) be the complete zero-run gaps.  Form
+\[
+ \widehat S_k=K_N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\mathbf1_{\{G_j\ge k\}},
+ \qquad0\le k\le2n-1,
+\tag{3.17}
+\]
+with fixed values when \(K_N=0\).  Solve the empirical Hankel recurrence on
+its nonsingular gate, use a fixed fallback otherwise, and select measurably
+from a finite analytic contour atlas separating the unique two-root cluster
+from the \(n-2\) simple roots.  In the cluster, use its elementary symmetric
+coordinates and transform them analytically to \((c,\widetilde\delta)\);
+set \(\widehat\delta=(\widetilde\delta)^+\).  The resulting estimators are
+total and Borel measurable and satisfy, uniformly over the compact stratum and
+bounded local alternatives,
+\[
+ \widehat\eta_N-\eta_N=O_P(N^{-1/2}),\qquad
+ \widehat\delta_N-\delta_N=O_P(N^{-1/2}).
+\tag{3.18}
+\]
+The pair \(\widehat c_N\pm\sqrt{\widehat\delta_N}\), together with the
+canonically ordered simple-rate estimates, gives \textup{(3.13)}.
+\end{estimator}
+
+The finite vector of empirical tail coordinates is root-\(N\), and
+invertibility from \Cref{prop:serial-tail-coordinates-main} gives root-\(N\)
+recurrence coefficients.  Simple roots and the two-root cluster have
+compatible analytic charts, while \((c,\delta)\) are regular analytic cluster
+coordinates.  Projection onto \([0,\infty)\) is nonexpansive, and
+\(|\sqrt{x^+}-\sqrt y|\le\sqrt{|x-y|}\) for \(y\ge0\).  The finite-atlas
+contour construction and measurability proof are in
+\Cref*{sec:estimator-atlas-supp} of the supplementary material.
+
+For the collision test, write the null one-cycle score as
+\[
+ s_{\eta,0}(k)=
+ \begin{pmatrix}s_{\rm nuis}(k;\eta)\\s_\delta(k;\eta)\end{pmatrix}.
+\]
+Fix a compact null-coordinate neighbourhood \(\mathcal E_0\) whose interior
+contains the stratum projection and whose closure lies in the common score
+chart.  For \(\eta\in\mathcal E_0\), define the empirical calendar information
+\[
+ I_N(\eta)=\frac1N\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}
+ s_{\eta,0}(G_j)s_{\eta,0}(G_j)^\top,
+\tag{3.19}
+\]
+and set \(I_N(\eta)=0\) outside \(\mathcal E_0\).  Partition it according to
+\((\eta,\delta)\), and define its empirical Schur complement by
+\[
+ J_N(\eta)=
+ \begin{cases}
+ I_{\delta\delta,N}-I_{\delta\eta,N}
+ I_{\eta\eta,N}^{-1}I_{\eta\delta,N},
+ &\eta\in\mathcal E_0,\ \lambda_{\min}(I_{\eta\eta,N})>0,\\
+ 0,&\text{otherwise}.
+ \end{cases}
+\tag{3.20}
+\]
+Let \(\widehat\eta_N\) be the recurrence fit and
+\(\mathcal G_N=\{\widehat\eta_N\in\mathcal E_0,
+J_N(\widehat\eta_N)>0\}\).  On \(\mathcal G_N\), put
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ Z_N&=\frac{N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}
+ \left[s_\delta(G_j;\widehat\eta_N)
+ -I_{\delta\eta,N}(\widehat\eta_N)
+ I_{\eta\eta,N}(\widehat\eta_N)^{-1}
+ s_{\rm nuis}(G_j;\widehat\eta_N)\right]}
+ {\sqrt{J_N(\widehat\eta_N)}},\\
+ \phi_N&=\mathbf1_{\{Z_N>z_{1-\alpha}\}}.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{3.21}
+\]
+The score-chart, singular-block, and nonpositive-Schur-complement gates make
+the construction total: off \(\mathcal G_N\), set \(\phi_N=0\), the default
+nonrejection.  These gates are uniformly asymptotically inactive.

 \section{Proof of the limit-experiment theorem}
 
+The proof uses the following exact supplementary inputs.  Their proofs are
+\Cref*{lem:uniform-sampled-bin-tail-score-main,lem:uniform-stopped-renewal-score-main,lem:efficient-score-plugin-main}
+of the supplementary material.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),
+\[
+ N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}H_q(G_j)
+ -\mu_q^{-1}\EE_qH_q(G)\longrightarrow0
+\]
+uniformly in probability.  If \(B_q\) has a common polynomial envelope, then
+\[
+ N^{-3/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}B_q(G_j)=o_P(1)
+\]
+uniformly.  These conclusions hold jointly and apply to the score, stopped
+Hessian, and third-order likelihood remainder under bounded root-\(N\) local
+triangular arrays.
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Plug-in equicontinuity.}
+On the canonically ordered collision stratum, write the one-cycle null scores
+as \(s_\eta\) and \(s_\delta\), and define
+\[
+ \psi_\eta=s_\delta-I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}s_\eta,
+ \qquad
+ \Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)=N^{-1/2}
+ \sum_{j=1}^{K_N}\psi_\eta(G_j).
+\]
+For every fixed \(L<\infty\),
+\[
+ \sup_\eta\sup_{\|\eta'-\eta\|\le L/\sqrt N}
+ |\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta')-\Delta_{{\rm eff},N}(\eta)|
+ =o_{P_{\eta,0}}(1).
+\]
+The conclusion also holds under bounded contiguous local alternatives.  The
+empirical calendar information and its Schur complement, evaluated anywhere
+in the same root-\(N\) ball, converge uniformly to \(I_n(\eta)\) and
+\(J_n(\eta)\).  Hence any measurable root-\(N\) null fit may be inserted in
+the standardized efficient central sequence with an \(o_P(1)\) change.
+

+compatible analytic charts, while \((c,\delta)\) are regular analytic cluster

+\(|\sqrt{x^+}-\sqrt y|\le\sqrt{|x-y|}\) for \(y\ge0\).  The finite-atlas
+contour construction and measurability proof are in

+For the collision test, write the null one-cycle score as
+\[
+ s_{\eta,0}(k)=
+ \begin{pmatrix}s_{\rm nuis}(k;\eta)\\s_\delta(k;\eta)\end{pmatrix}.

+Fix a compact null-coordinate neighbourhood \(\mathcal E_0\) whose interior
+contains the stratum projection and whose closure lies in the common score
+chart.  For \(\eta\in\mathcal E_0\), define the empirical calendar information
+\[
+ I_N(\eta)=\frac1N\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}
+ s_{\eta,0}(G_j)s_{\eta,0}(G_j)^\top,
+\tag{3.19}
+\]

+\[
+ J_N(\eta)=

+ I_{\delta\delta,N}-I_{\delta\eta,N}
+ I_{\eta\eta,N}^{-1}I_{\eta\delta,N},
+ &\eta\in\mathcal E_0,\ \lambda_{\min}(I_{\eta\eta,N})>0,\\
+ 0,&\text{otherwise}.
+ \end{cases}
+\tag{3.20}
+\]
+Let \(\widehat\eta_N\) be the recurrence fit and
+\(\mathcal G_N=\{\widehat\eta_N\in\mathcal E_0,
+J_N(\widehat\eta_N)>0\}\).  On \(\mathcal G_N\), put
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ Z_N&=\frac{N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}
+ \left[s_\delta(G_j;\widehat\eta_N)
+ -I_{\delta\eta,N}(\widehat\eta_N)
+ I_{\eta\eta,N}(\widehat\eta_N)^{-1}
+ s_{\rm nuis}(G_j;\widehat\eta_N)\right]}
+ {\sqrt{J_N(\widehat\eta_N)}},\\
+ \phi_N&=\mathbf1_{\{Z_N>z_{1-\alpha}\}}.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{3.21}
+\]
+The score-chart, singular-block, and nonpositive-Schur-complement gates make
+the construction total: off \(\mathcal G_N\), set \(\phi_N=0\), the default
+nonrejection.  These gates are uniformly asymptotically inactive.

 \section{Proof of the limit-experiment theorem}
 
+The proof uses the following exact supplementary inputs.  Their proofs are
+\Cref*{lem:uniform-sampled-bin-tail-score-main,lem:uniform-stopped-renewal-score-main,lem:efficient-score-plugin-main}
+of the supplementary material.
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]

**Theorem 4 Verbatim**

> **Theorem 4 (Stationary isolated-double-pole limit experiment).** Fix \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), known \(\Delta\tau>0\), and the serial positive killed-reset realization (1.2)–(1.3), and suppose \(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\ne\varnothing\). Let \(P_{\eta,\delta}^{(N)}\) be the stationary length-\(N\) binary renewal record in this fixed serial order, at one isolated real double pole with all other rates simple and separated as in (3.1).
>
> **(A) Uniform LAN and the limit experiment.** For bounded \(u\in\mathbb R^{n-1}\) and \(v\in[0,\infty)\), uniformly over the collision stratum,
> \[
> \log\frac{dP_{\eta_0+u/\sqrt N,v/\sqrt N}^{(N)}}{dP_{\eta_0,0}^{(N)}}
> =\binom uv^{\!\top}\Delta_{N,\eta_0}
> -\frac12\binom uv^{\!\top}I_n(\eta_0)\binom uv
> +o_{P_{\eta_0,0}}(1),
> \]
> where \(\Delta_{N,\eta_0}\Rightarrow\mathcal N_n\{0,I_n(\eta_0)\}\) uniformly in bounded-Lipschitz distance. The local experiments converge to the Gaussian shift on \(\mathbb R^{n-1}\times[0,\infty)\), and the information is uniformly nondegenerate by (3.5).
>
> **(B) Efficient collision test.** Partition \(I_n\) according to \((\eta,\delta)\) and set
> \[
> J_n(\eta)=I_{\delta\delta}-I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}I_{\eta\delta}>0.
> \]
> The residualized-score test \(\phi_N\) in (3.21) has uniform asymptotic level \(\alpha\). At \((\eta_N,\delta_N)=(\eta_0+u/\sqrt N,v/\sqrt N)\), its limiting power is
> \[
> 1-\Phi_{\rm N}\{z_{1-\alpha}-v\sqrt{J_n(\eta_0)}\}.
> \]
> This is the Gaussian half-space power envelope among tests with uniform local asymptotic level \(\alpha\).
>
> **(C) Attainable and lower recovery rates.** The measurable procedure in Estimator 7 gives root-\(N\) estimates of \(\eta\) and \(\delta\) and an induced rate multiset \(\widehat{\mathcal R}_{n,N}\) satisfying
> \[
> d_{\rm m}\!\left(\widehat{\mathcal R}_{n,N},
> \{\!\{c_N+\sqrt{\delta_N},c_N-\sqrt{\delta_N},
> \theta_{3,N},\ldots,\theta_{n,N}\}\!\}\right)=O_P(N^{-1/4})
> \]
> uniformly over the compact stratum and bounded \((u,v)\). The centre and canonically ordered separated rates remain root-\(N\). At every fixed base, Lemma 6 gives a strictly positive lower limit for threshold risk on two alternatives separated by \(\sqrt{v_0}N^{-1/4}\). Hence \(N^{-1/4}\) is uniformly attainable on the stated bounded local families and pointwise locally minimax-optimal in rate.

+ \begin{pmatrix}s_{\rm nuis}(k;\eta)\\s_\delta(k;\eta)\end{pmatrix}.

+\[

+the construction total: off \(\mathcal G_N\), set \(\phi_N=0\), the default
+nonrejection.  These gates are uniformly asymptotically inactive.

 \section{Proof of the limit-experiment theorem}
 
+The proof uses the following exact supplementary inputs.  Their proofs are
+\Cref*{lem:uniform-sampled-bin-tail-score-main,lem:uniform-stopped-renewal-score-main,lem:efficient-score-plugin-main}
+of the supplementary material.

+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{DQM and envelope.}
+For fixed \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), and \(\Delta\tau>0\), there is a common
+physical one-sided neighbourhood \(\mathcal Q^+\) of
+\(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\), in the coordinates
+\(q=(\eta,\delta)\), on which \(c\pm\sqrt\delta>0\) and, for every
+multi-index \(a\),
+\[
+\begin{aligned}
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log g_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le3,\\
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q^+}|\partial_q^a\log S_q(k)|
+ &\le C_a(1+k)^{2|a|},&& 1\le|a|\le2.
+\end{aligned}
+\]
+All parameter derivatives extend continuously to \(\delta=0\), and
+\(g_q(k)\le C(1+k)^{n-1}r^k\) for a common \(r<1\).  Writing
+\(e_q(a)=S_q(a)/\mu_q\), the families \(g_q\) and \(e_q\) are uniformly
+differentiable in quadratic mean.  Uniformly over base points on the collision
+stratum and bounded physical root-\(N\) local arrays \(q_N\),
+\[
+ H^2(g_{q_N},g_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ H^2(e_{q_N},e_{q_0})=O(N^{-1}),\qquad
+ |\mu_{q_N}-\mu_{q_0}|=O(N^{-1/2}).
+\]
+
+\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Stopped-score CLT and information LLN.}
+Let \(\mathcal Q\) be compact and let the integer Palm gaps \(G\) have full
+support, a common exponential moment, and parameter-continuous masses.  Let a
+stationary binary renewal record of length \(N\) contain \(K_N\) complete
+gaps, with initial forward recurrence \(A_N\) and terminal backward recurrence
+\(R_N\), and put \(D=G+1\), \(\mu_q=\EE_qD\).  Uniformly in
+\(q\in\mathcal Q\), and for triangular arrays \(q_N\in\mathcal Q\),
+\[
+ K_N=N/\mu_{q_N}+O_{P_{q_N}}(\sqrt N),\qquad
+ \max\{A_N,R_N,G_1,\ldots,G_{K_N}\}=O_{P_{q_N}}(\log N).
+\]
+If \(b_q(G)\in\RR^d\) is parameter-continuous, \(\EE_qb_q(G)=0\), and is
+bounded by a common polynomial in \(G\), then
+\[
+ \sup_{q\in\mathcal Q}d_{\rm BL}\!\left(
+ \mathcal L_q\!\left[N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^{K_N}b_q(G_j)\right],
+ \mathcal N_d\!\left(0,\mu_q^{-1}\EE_q[b_qb_q^\top]\right)
+ \right)\longrightarrow0.
+\]
+For every similarly dominated matrix reward \(H_q\),

**Theorem 4 Verbatim**

> **Theorem 4 (Stationary isolated-double-pole limit experiment).** Fix \(n,\varepsilon,M,c_0\), known \(\Delta\tau>0\), and the serial positive killed-reset realization (1.2)–(1.3), and suppose \(\mathcal C_n(\varepsilon,M,c_0)\ne\varnothing\). Let \(P_{\eta,\delta}^{(N)}\) be the stationary length-\(N\) binary renewal record in this fixed serial order, at one isolated real double pole with all other rates simple and separated as in (3.1).
>
> **(A) Uniform LAN and the limit experiment.** For bounded \(u\in\mathbb R^{n-1}\) and \(v\in[0,\infty)\), uniformly over the collision stratum,
> \[
> \log\frac{dP_{\eta_0+u/\sqrt N,v/\sqrt N}^{(N)}}{dP_{\eta_0,0}^{(N)}}
> =\binom uv^{\!\top}\Delta_{N,\eta_0}
> -\frac12\binom uv^{\!\top}I_n(\eta_0)\binom uv
> +o_{P_{\eta_0,0}}(1),
> \]
> where \(\Delta_{N,\eta_0}\Rightarrow\mathcal N_n\{0,I_n(\eta_0)\}\) uniformly in bounded-Lipschitz distance. The local experiments converge to the Gaussian shift on \(\mathbb R^{n-1}\times[0,\infty)\), and the information is uniformly nondegenerate by (3.5).
>
> **(B) Efficient collision test.** Partition \(I_n\) according to \((\eta,\delta)\) and set
> \[
> J_n(\eta)=I_{\delta\delta}-I_{\delta\eta}I_{\eta\eta}^{-1}I_{\eta\delta}>0.
> \]
> The residualized-score test \(\phi_N\) in (3.21) has uniform asymptotic level \(\alpha\). At \((\eta_N,\delta_N)=(\eta_0+u/\sqrt N,v/\sqrt N)\), its limiting power is
> \[
> 1-\Phi_{\rm N}\{z_{1-\alpha}-v\sqrt{J_n(\eta_0)}\}.
> \]
> This is the Gaussian half-space power envelope among tests with uniform local asymptotic level \(\alpha\).
>
> **(C) Attainable and lower recovery rates.** The measurable procedure in Estimator 7 gives root-\(N\) estimates of \(\eta\) and \(\delta\) and an induced rate multiset \(\widehat{\mathcal R}_{n,N}\) satisfying
> \[
> d_{\rm m}\!\left(\widehat{\mathcal R}_{n,N},
> \{\!\{c_N+\sqrt{\delta_N},c_N-\sqrt{\delta_N},
> \theta_{3,N},\ldots,\theta_{n,N}\}\!\}\right)=O_P(N^{-1/4})
> \]
> uniformly over the compact stratum and bounded \((u,v)\). The centre and canonically ordered separated rates remain root-\(N\). At every fixed base, Lemma 6 gives a strictly positive lower limit for threshold risk on two alternatives separated by \(\sqrt{v_0}N^{-1/4}\). Hence \(N^{-1/4}\) is uniformly attainable on the stated bounded local families and pointwise locally minimax-optimal in rate.
